description.value: Mountain Man Mike's runs a weekly shuttle from Kaslo to Calgary via Balfour, Nelson, Salmo, Creston, Cranbrook, Fernie, Sparwood, Pincher Creek, Fort Macleod, Claresholm, High River and Okotoks — eastbound every Monday, westbound (Calgary–Kaslo) every Tuesday. It also runs Vancouver–Kootenays twice weekly. This is the only ground service that reaches Calgary via Cranbrook. Bikes appear to be accepted but the fee isn't published; oversized items like bicycles have separate additional fees discussed with the booking agent, so call ahead (778-382-7729) to confirm cost and packaging before booking.
